chunks: Beware that plenty of wealth is a blessing
but better than plenty of wealth is the health of the body
while still better than the health of the body is the chastity of heart

key_terms.سَعَةُ الْمَالِ: plenty of wealth / abundance of property

ai.seo_question: What is the hierarchy of blessings in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali establishes a spiritual hierarchy where material wealth is the least significant, physical health is superior, and the purity of the heart (taqwa al-qalb) is the ultimate blessing. This reflects the Shia emphasis on inner spiritual states over external circumstances, aligning with the concept of 'fitrah' (innate disposition) being preserved through divine consciousness. The narration serves as a practical guide for prioritizing spiritual maintenance alongside physical and material well-being.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Beware that plenty of wealth is a blessing,
but better than plenty of wealth is the health of the body,
while still better than the health of the body is the chastity of heart.
